case_name: Portfolio missing viewport + H1 + meta description

fixes.fix_explanation: This tag tells mobile browsers to set the page width to the device width and prevents automatic zooming, making the site responsive on phones and tablets.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the charset meta tag and before the <title> tag.

fixes.fix_explanation: Every page needs one H1 heading to tell search engines and screen readers the main topic; it should match or closely reflect the page title.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <body> element, preferably as the first visible heading near the top of the page, above or within the site header.

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="Portfolio of Jane Doe, a UX designer and illustrator crafting intuitive digital experiences and visual storytelling for brands worldwide.">
fixes.fix_explanation: The meta description appears in search results below the page title and helps users decide to click; it should summarize the page and include key terms.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the <title> tag and before the Open Graph meta tags.
